payload.reason: The evidence explains that prior knowledge distillation techniques are ineffective for producing student models with different vocabularies because they require the student and teacher models to share the same vocabulary and output space, which limits their ability to reduce model sizes effectively.

claims.text: Knowledge distillation techniques require the student and teacher models to share the same vocabulary, limiting their effectiveness in producing student models with different vocabularies.

The input vocabulary size and corresponding word embedding matrix account for a significant proportion of model parameters, making it challenging to distill knowledge effectively when vocabularies differ.
Existing distillation techniques cannot utilize reduced vocabulary sizes because they depend on shared vocabularies between teacher and student models.
